migri: My name is Migri, your virtual assistant.
I'm here to help you with using the iMigration app.
This app is designed to help you navigate the complex world of immigration services!
Whether you're looking to apply for a visa, understand your rights, or find resources, I'm here to assist you every step of the way.

welcome: This is the home screen where you can find all the services we offer.
You can browse through different categories such as visas, citizenship, and legal assistance.
Tap on any service to learn more about it and see if it fits your needs.
If you need help or have questions, just tap the 'Lightbulb' icon in the bottom right corner to chat with me!
Welcome to the i589 application for asylum!
This application will guide you through the process of completing and submitting your asylum application to the U.S. government.
The application is divided into several sections, each focusing on different aspects of your personal information, background, and reasons for seeking asylum.
You will be asked to provide detailed answers to various questions, as well as upload any supporting documents that may help strengthen your case.
Please take your time to read each question carefully and provide accurate and honest answers.
If you are unsure about any question or need assistance, consider consulting with one of our legal experts or support staff.

statement.description: Provide a detailed personal statement describing your background, experiences, and reasons for seeking asylum. This statement will be an important part of your application.
statement.title: Personal Statement
statement.label: Statement

intro.title: Personal Statement
intro.description: We are going to ask you some specific questions about your situation and your asylum request. You will need to provide detailed answers to these questions. Remember that you can correct and change anything you need before finishing. If you don't have or don't remember something, continue and come back later. It is important to remember that everything you write or say and the documents, photos, or any other information you include or send is your responsibility to be true to the best of your knowledge and belief.

has-fear.title: Are you afraid to return to your country? If you have to return, are you afraid that you or your family might suffer harm or mistreatment?

details.title: Fear of returning to your country
details.description:
Please explain in detail why you are afraid to return to your country. In your explanation, try to include the following information:

What harm or mistreatment you fear may happen if you return.

Who you believe might harm or mistreat you.

Whether anything has changed since you left that might affect the risk of harm or mistreatment. For example, is the situation the same, has it improved, or has it gotten worse? Please explain why.

Why you believe you could be harmed or mistreated if you return.

Any additional information that may help explain your fear of returning.

documents.title: Documents related to your fear of return
documents.description: Please submit any documents that may help confirm the information you have provided about your fear of returning. This may include police reports, letters, screenshots, medical records, photographs, or any other relevant documents.

has-criminal-history.description: Have you or any family member included in this application ever committed a crime or been arrested, charged, convicted, or sentenced for any offense in the United States (including violations of immigration laws)?

details.title: Details of criminal history
details.description:
Provide detailed information for each instance:

What happened and under what circumstances?
When did it occur?
What was the sentence received, and what were the place and length of detention or imprisonment?
What were the reasons for the detention or conviction?
What formal charges were brought against you or your family members included in this application, and what were the reasons for your/their release?

documents.title: Criminal history documents
documents.description: Please submit any documents related to your or your family's criminal history. This may include court records, police reports, or any other relevant documents.

final-declaration.title: Final Declaration
final-declaration.description: I swear (affirm) that I know the contents of this application that I am signing, including all attached documents and supplements, and that they are all true to the best of my knowledge and belief. I also understand that if it is determined that I knowingly filed a frivolous asylum application, I will be permanently ineligible for any benefit under the Immigration and Nationality Act, and that I cannot avoid a finding of a frivolous application simply because someone advised me to provide false information in my asylum application.

has-fear-of-torture.title: Are you afraid of being tortured in your country or in any other country to which you may be returned?
has-fear-of-torture.description: Similar to the previous question, but not only about fear of harm or mistreatment — this one is about fear of being tortured.

details.description:
Please explain in detail why you are afraid that you or your family may be tortured if you return to your country. In your explanation, try to include the following information:

What you fear may happen if you return.

Who you believe might harm or torture you.

Whether anything has changed since you left that might affect this fear. For example, is the situation the same, has it improved, or has it gotten worse? Please explain why.

Why you believe you may be harmed or tortured if you return.

Any additional information that may help explain your fear of returning.

documents.title: Documents related to your fear of torture
documents.description: Please submit any documents that may help confirm the information you have provided about your fear of torture. This may include police reports, letters, screenshots, medical records, photographs, or any other relevant documents.

has-been-harmed.title: Have you, your family, close friends, or co-workers suffered any harm, mistreatment, or threats?

documents.title: Documents related to your harm and/or persecution
documents.description: Please submit any documents that may help confirm the information you have provided about your harm and/or persecution. This may include police reports, letters, screenshots, medical records, photographs, or any other relevant documents.

details.title: Details of your harm and/or persecution
details.description:
Please describe in detail any incidents when you or your family suffered harm, were threatened, or were mistreated.

When describing your experience, please include as much detail as possible. In your explanation, try to address the following:

What happened and how it happened.

When it happened. Indicate whether it was a single incident or if it happened many times.

Who was responsible. If you do not know their names, explain whether they belonged to a group, gang, cartel, political group, or were part of the government.

Why you believe you or your family were harmed, mistreated, or threatened.

Any additional information. Include anything else you can share that may help us better understand what happened.

has-international-criminal-history.title: Have you ever been arrested, charged, or convicted for a crime in any country other than the United States?

details.title: International criminal history details
details.description:
Please provide details about your arrest, charge, or conviction. Include the following information:

The country where the incident occurred.

The date of the incident.

The nature of the crime.

The outcome (e.g., acquitted, convicted, case dismissed).

Any additional relevant information.

documents.title: International criminal history documents
documents.description: Please submit any documents related to your arrest, charge, or conviction. This may include court records, police reports, or any other relevant documents.

has-current-organizational-affiliations.description: Do you or your family continue participating in these groups or organizations?

has-past-organizational-affiliations.description: Have you or any member of your family ever belonged to or been associated with any organization or group in your country of origin, such as, but not limited to, a political party, a student group, a labor union, a religious organization, a military or paramilitary group, a civil patrol, a guerrilla organization, an ethnic group, a human rights group, or the press or media?

current-affiliations-details.title: Current membership and group affiliation details
current-affiliations-details.description:
Please describe in detail the current level of participation for each person who is involved:

How do they participate?

What is your or your family member’s current level of participation?

Do you or your family members currently hold leadership positions or important roles? If so, which position?

How long have you or your family member(s) participated in that organization or group?

past-affiliations-details.title: Past membership and group affiliation details
past-affiliations-details.description:
Please provide details about your involvement with the gang or group. Include the following information:

The name of the gang or group.

The nature of your involvement.

The time period of your involvement.

Any criminal activities you were involved in.

Any additional relevant information.

current-affiliations-documents.title: Current membership and group affiliation documents
current-affiliations-documents.description: Please submit any documents related to you or your family's current membership or affiliation with any organization or group which may help confirm the information you have provided. This may include membership cards, letters, photographs, or any other relevant documents.

past-affiliations-documents.title: Past membership and group affiliation documents
past-affiliations-documents.description: Please submit any documents related to you or your family's past membership or affiliation with any organization or group which may help confirm the information you have provided. This may include membership cards, letters, photographs, or any other relevant documents.

has-previous-applications.description: Have you, your spouse, your child(ren), your father, your mother, or your siblings ever applied to the United States Government for refugee status, asylum, or withholding of removal?

details.title: Details of Prior Application
details.description:
What happened? Was there a decision, and if so, what was the decision?

What happened to the status that you, your spouse, your child(ren), your father, your mother, or your sibling(s) received as a result of that decision?

Were you included in the application of your father, mother, or spouse? If you were included, what was the A-Number of your father, mother, or spouse?

If an immigration judge or the Board of Immigration Appeals denied your asylum, please explain: what has changed in the conditions of your country or in your personal situation since your application was denied? Why is your case different now?

has-returned-to-country.description: After you left your country to come to the United States (or the country where you suffered harm or fear harm), did you return to that country?

details.title: Explanation of travel to home country
details.description:
Explain in detail:
Why did you return?
When did you return?
How long did you stay?

documents.title: Documents related to travel to home country
documents.description: Please submit any documents that may help confirm the information you have provided about your travel to your home country. This may include travel tickets, passport stamps, or any other relevant documents.

has-harm-participation.description: Have you, your spouse, or your child(ren) ever ordered, incited, assisted, or otherwise participated in causing harm or suffering to any person because of their race, religion, nationality, membership in a particular social group, or belief in a particular political opinion?

details.title: Details of involvement
details.description: Provide a detailed description of each incident, specifying your involvement and/or the involvement of your family members.

documents.title: Documents related to involvement in harm or persecution
documents.description: Please submit any documents that may help confirm the information you have provided about your or your family's involvement. This may include court records, police reports, letters, or any other relevant documents.

has-international-immigration-history.description: Have you, your spouse, your child(ren), or other family members such as your father, mother, or siblings ever applied for or received any legal status in a country other than the one from which you are now requesting asylum?

details.title: Explanation of legal status in another country
details.description:
Provide a detailed explanation of what happened with that legal status, for you or any of your family members. Include the following:

Where — in which country did this occur?
What was your status while you were in that country?
What was the reason you left?
Do you have the right to return with “legal residence”?
Did you apply for refugee or asylum status while living in that country? Explain why or why not.

documents.title: Documents related to legal status in another country
documents.description: Please submit any documents that may help confirm the information you have provided about your or your family's legal status in another country. This may include visas, residence permits, asylum or refugee status documents, or any other relevant documents.

reasons.title: Reasons for seeking asylum
reasons.description: Based on your previous answers and explanations, indicate the reasons you are requesting asylum. You may select one or more reasons.

details.title: Late Application Explanation
details.description:
It has already been more than a year since you entered the United States. The U.S. government requires that this application be submitted within one year. Please explain in great detail why you were not able to submit this application within one year of your entry into the United States.

It is very important that you explain in detail why you were not able to meet that deadline (for example, if you were sick and hospitalized: What happened to you? How long were you in the hospital? In which hospital were you treated?)

eligible.nextSteps: You can now proceed with your I-589 application for asylum. The following steps will guide you through the process.
eligible.title: You May Be Eligible for Asylum
